Pree, I've noted your 21 October cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork in this DM, but I can't confirm I'll keep it for future conversations, so please don't rely on me to remember it.

I sent two replies. The first one made claims about how my memory works that I hadn't checked, and the second corrects them. If you want the cutoff tracked, I can put it on your calendar or in a file.
